Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4970 of 2024
Petitioner :- Punit Kumar

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rakesh Kumar Mishra,Anupam Bajpai

Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State/opposite parties and perused the record.

This petition seeks issuance of direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned F.I.R.
dated 17.9.2023, bearing Case Crime No. 0154/2023, for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 504,
506 I.P.C. and 66D of I.T. Act, registered at Police Station Naveen Modern Police Thana , District Shrawasti.

entities.text: Police Station Naveen Modern Police Thana , District Shrawasti
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the offences, as alleged, in FIR have maximum Punit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84808254/
1 punishment for the term less than seven years imprisonment, whereas, the police is trying to arrest him, which is against the mandates of Code of Criminal Procedure.

entities.text: Punit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Additional Government Advocate appearing for respondent State has given a statement on behalf of investigating agency that because the offence allegedly committed by the petitioners, entails sentence of less than seven years, provisions of Section 41-A Cr.P.C. shall be strictly followed in terms of judgment rendered by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in a case reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the stand of the investigating agency, learned counsel for the petitioner states that let this petition be disposed of in view of the above said facts.

Accordingly, this petition is disposed of in view of the provisions of Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and the law as laid down by Apex Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar (supra).
.
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 15.7.2024 AKK  Punit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ...
